title: The Farm System
description: Pinewood Pee-Wee Baseball calls in to hype Saturday's under-nines championship. Commissioner Glenda runs the booster club like a front office with a sportsbook bolted on. One dad finds out his seven-year-old got traded.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're back on Snazzie FM, and tonight it's all heart. The Pinewood Pee-Wee League is on the line to hype Saturday's under-nines championship. Commissioner Glenda, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Under-nines. So these are children, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Thank you, Ronnie. For the love of the game, sweetheart, it's an honor. Pinewood's had a strong quarter. Strong roster, strong gate, strong... numbers.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that is the heart of youth sports, Barry. A community coming together.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: We move a lot of orange slices, Ronnie. And what we move on top of the orange slices, well, that stays in the lockbox.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: What's in the lockbox, Glenda?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: The gate, sweetheart. The gate goes through the snack bar, and the snack bar comes out clean.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's money laundering, Ronnie. She's laundering money through a snack bar.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Or it's a well-run concession stand, Barry. Let's not put a felony on a fundraiser. Glenda, who do we like Saturday?

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Pinewood minus four and a half, Ronnie. Line's been moving all week. Heavy action on the under.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [surprise-ah] Who is that? Who put a SPREAD on second-graders?

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: That's Sal. I run the snack bar window. Hot dogs on the left, the book on the right. <p:0.3> Riverside's a dog, take the points.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Sal handles the lines, sweetheart. I handle the assets.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The assets? Glenda, the assets are SEVEN.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Yeah, hi, Ronnie, I gotta jump in, this is Darnell, Tyler's dad. <p:0.3> Somebody just told me my son got traded to Riverside?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Ah. Darnell. For the love of the game, sweetheart, that's already done. Tyler went to Riverside Thursday. Clean deal.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: He's SEVEN! Nobody called the house! He plays for FUN, Glenda, he plays for the snacks!

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: And we got a strong package back. A shortstop, a future draft pick, and a cooler.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now a cooler is a real piece, Barry. You can't win a July doubleheader without a cooler.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Oh, a trade? Aw, that sounds lovely! <p:0.3> Is this for the snack rotation? Because I am DOWN for oranges this week, I do a beautiful orange slice.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] Linda, nobody traded the oranges. They traded a child.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Aw, that sounds lovely! Will there still be orange slices though?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Glenda, give me back my kid. He's not a... a draft pick, he's a BOY, he likes the dugout because it has shade!

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Here's the thing, sweetheart. Tyler's a Pinewood asset on loan. Riverside has him for the season. We hold his rights.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: And the line says he plays Saturday. Tyler at short, Pinewood minus four and a half. <p:0.3> Against the team he just got traded to.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait. So Tyler plays FOR Riverside, AGAINST Pinewood, who own him, who you bet on to win?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Now you're getting it, Barry. That's why the under's so juicy. Tyler knows to take the day off.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's a point-shaving ring, Ronnie. With a seven-year-old as the inside man.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: He's SEVEN! He can't shave points, he can't TIE HIS CLEATS!

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Cleats untied is a soft scratch. Line drops a run.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: We'll also need a player to be named later.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Named WHEN? Who?!

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: It was always Tyler, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: You traded him for HIMSELF?!

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Aw, that sounds lovely!

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: And the cooler!

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: The cooler was the real piece, Darnell. <p:0.3> Tyler was just how we got the cooler.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: They moved a child to acquire a CHILLED BEVERAGE container.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And THAT, Barry, is grassroots community spirit. Booster clubs building dreams, one roster move at a time. <p:0.3> We'll be right back after Saturday's game, which, statistically, Pinewood already won.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I want my son OFF the roster, Glenda. Tonight.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Can't, sweetheart. Tyler's got a no-trade clause. <p:0.3> Which, for the love of the game, I'm about to void. <p:0.3> Orange-slice tribute's due Saturday, Darnell. Don't be late.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Ooh, I'll bring the oranges!
